derivation.behavior: WorkManager/FGS/UIDT provide execution opportunity but not scheduler policy.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Android wakes/hosts Go, forwards runtime conditions and retry deadlines, suppresses duplicate workers, and never duplicates retry/queue eligibility decisions in Kotlin.

invariants: Android primitives wake and keep the host alive; they do not select retry/backoff/queue eligibility.
Duplicate WorkManager or start events cannot create duplicate engine attempts.
Boot/package restart restores the Go engine before scheduler recovery decisions are made.
Runtime condition snapshots are forwarded to the Go scheduler for authoritative eligibility.
